children: UK sustainable building products supplier's FY26 revenue fell 6% amid subdued commercial demand
Housebuilding Products division grew revenue 16% despite weak UK housebuilding market
Alumasc says FY27 has started positively, with revenue up 5% year-on-year in first two months
Company order book at 31 Aug 2026 up 56% on prior year
Board expects improved FY27 margins, supported by restructuring and operational improvements
HOUSEBUILDING PRODUCTS GAINS - Division grew revenue 16% in a weak market, driven by market share gains, product innovation and strong customer service
WATER MANAGEMENT DECLINE - Revenue fell 16% due to non-recurrence of CLK Airport project and subdued UK demand, partially offset by export growth
RESTRUCTURING SAVINGS - Efficiency measures in Water Management delivered £1.3m annualised overhead savings in FY26
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Alumasc Group PLC is GBp344.00, about 44.8% above its September 14 closing price of GBp237.50
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
